hero.title:
Good ideas grow
through collaboration.
hero.description: We welcome schools, student groups, businesses, and community partners who want to make low-carbon living more accessible. Let's explore what we can build together.

purpose.title: Turn climate awareness into everyday action.
purpose.description: CarbonTrack brings together carbon-footprint tools, community participation, and climate storytelling. Through collaboration, we hope to help more people understand their impact and take practical steps toward a lower-carbon future.

areas.title: Ways to work together
areas.description: These are starting points for a conversation. We are also happy to hear ideas that connect your strengths with our environmental mission.

community.title: Campus & community
community.description: Explore low-carbon challenges, environmental workshops, and community activities that help people turn everyday choices into action.

technology.title: Product & technology
technology.description: Collaborate on development, testing, and user experience across carbon-footprint tools, our website, mobile app, and browser extension.

creative.title: Content & creative projects
creative.description: Create climate explainers, visual stories, and interactive exhibitions that make environmental issues easier to understand and experience.

support.title: Resources & long-term support
support.description: Discuss support through venues, expertise, outreach, or funding to help CarbonTrack develop a sustainable operating model.

process.title: From an idea to a shared project

steps.title: Share your idea
steps.description: Tell us about yourself or your organization, your proposed collaboration, who it could reach, and your timeline.

steps.title: Find common ground
steps.description: Together, we can discuss available resources, responsibilities, and what a useful outcome would look like.

steps.title: Start small, learn together
steps.description: Begin with a clearly scoped project, review the feedback, and decide together what comes next.

contact.title: Let's start with an idea.
contact.description: Your proposal does not need to be fully formed. Send us a short introduction and the kind of collaboration you have in mind.
contact.subject: Partnership with CarbonTrack
contact.otherQuestions: Other questions? View our contact information.
